en.summary: Revenue grew 11.72% YoY, supported by iPhone and Services. GAAP gross margin includes a favorable tariff refund. Standalone quarterly free cash flow, reconstructed from cumulative statements, fell 2.37% YoY; cash realization differs from earnings growth.
findings: Revenue was $114.477B, up 11.72% YoY. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.10, up 13.51%. Product, service and regional trends differ and require separate analysis.

Calculated GAAP gross margin was 47.89%, up 0.71 percentage points YoY and down 2.17 points QoQ. The company disclosed a tariff refund adding approximately 1 percentage point to gross margin and $0.05 to EPS; persistence remains uncertain.

Reconstructed quarterly operating cash flow was $28.101B, down 5.47% YoY. Cash capital purchases were $2.242B; calculated free cash flow was $25.859B, down 2.37%. Revenue and profit growth therefore require separate cash-conversion checks.

Inventory increased to $14.541B from $11.092B last quarter; receivables rose to $43.817B from $31.398B. Seasonality, collections and payables need further review. These balances alone do not establish impairment or bad debts.

Quarterly repurchases were $24.296B and cash dividends/equivalents were $3.943B, totaling $28.239B versus $25.859B of calculated free cash flow. Cash balances and financing also matter when assessing this difference.

segments.name: Products and services: revenue categories
segments.text: iPhone revenue was $57.583B (+17.46% YoY), Services $31.573B (+9.82%), Mac $10.792B (+23.68%), iPad $6.229B (−10.4%) and Wearables/Home/Accessories $8.3B (−7.91%). Product categories overlap geographic segment totals.

segments.name: Greater China: geographic segment
segments.text: Revenue was $17.539B, up 21.02% YoY. Geographic and product revenue are two views of the same total. One quarter does not establish a long-term market-share trend.

limitations: Collected the official release and three consecutive financial-statement attachments; the formal filing and official call text were not collected.
Standalone quarterly cash flows are reconstructed by subtracting adjacent cumulative periods, including the YoY baseline. Full-year cash flow is not treated as Q4.
Free cash flow is calculated as quarterly operating cash flow less cash property and equipment purchases.
GAAP gross margin includes the tariff refund. No independently adjusted estimate is labeled GAAP.
No verifiable next-quarter numerical range was collected; guidance remains empty. No pre-release consensus snapshot was preserved.

metrics.label: GAAP gross margin
metrics.definition: GAAP gross profit divided by quarterly revenue.
